findings.evidence: `ContourIntegration/README.md:209` accepts “e.g. a Cauchy principal value”; `ContourIntegration/STATUS.md:21` says all worked-example criteria are realised by the existing PV theorem, while the listed frontier contains no Dirichlet-integral endpoint.
findings.fix: Tie this file to a specific open roadmap target for which the ordinary Dirichlet limit is necessary, or have the roadmap add that classical endpoint as a target before merging.
findings.issue: The new sine-integral API is peripheral to an already-satisfied acceptance criterion: the roadmap requires an improper integral such as a real-axis Cauchy principal value, and STATUS explicitly records the existing `tendsto_cauchyPV_realSegment_dirichlet` as completing it.

summary: This adds a useful-looking endpoint around a roadmap target that is already complete, without advancing any open ContourIntegration milestone.
